usage: kathara linfo [-h] [-d DIRECTORY] [-w | -c] [-n DEVICE_NAME | -t]

Show information about a Kathara network scenario

options:
  -h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
  -d, --directory DIRECTORY
                        Specify the folder containing the network scenario.
  -w, -l, --watch, --live
                        Watch mode, can be used only when a network scenario
                        is launched.
  -c, --conf            Read static information from lab.conf.
  -n, --name DEVICE_NAME
                        Show only information about a specified device.
  -t, --topology        Get running topology info

For examples and further information visit:
https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
